name: Acid Baselines Classics
author: Freek van Gool
description: Acid house and acid techno sounds for Acid Baselines, in the spirit of the classic eras: Chicago origins, rolling Frankfurt acid, minimal, squelch anthems, acid techno, acid trance, electro and deep acid. The AIcid folder goes further, with the extra oscillators, filter types and distortions of Acid Baselines 1.11.2, and the drum & bass folders (Neurofunk, Detune Stack, Liquid, Dancefloor DnB, Jump Up, Jungle) put them to work on 170 BPM bass lines. Each tune comes with its own bassline.
